messages.subject: [Rnomads-user] issues with r-forge version of rNOMADS
messages.subject_clean: [Rnomads-user] issues with r-forge version of rNOMADS
messages.body_plain:
Dear Daniel,
after days of perfect functioning, now it does not seem to work anymore.
The "ParseModelPage(urls.out [1])" command produces empty fields.
Thanks in advance
Andrea Bertolini

Il giorno ven 28 dic 2018 alle ore 22:50 Daniel Bowman <
danny.c.bowman at gmail.com> ha scritto:

> All,
>
> There's an issue with the tar archive on r-forge, so I'm attempting to
> attach a working version to this message.  Failing that, please just
> go ahead and download the .R files here:
>
>
> https://r-forge.r-project.org/scm/viewvc.php/trunk/rNOMADS/rNOMADS/R/?root=rnomads
>
> and source them.  I am sorry for the inconvenience!
>
> CRAN is back online on January 2nd, so unless you need these fixes
> urgently I'd just wait until I announce that the new version is online
> before installing.  Barring any issues that should be on the first
> week of January.
>
> Sorry for the inconvenience!
>
> Danny
> _______________________________________________
> Rnomads-user mailing list
> Rnomads-user at lists.r-forge.r-project.org
> http://lists.r-forge.r-project.org/cgi-bin/mailman/listinfo/rnomads-user

problems:

model.domain)
Error in GribGrab(urls.out[2], prev, levels, variables, model.domain =
model.domain) :
There is no prediction, level, or variable data present in the specified
model URL.
Perhaps the model has not been loaded yet; try using an earlier model run.

Hi Andrea,

There were some problems with https on the NOMADS site yesterday.  That was
probably what happened to you.

I sent out a notification on the rnomads mailing list and Twitter account.
If you are not following one of them, I encourage you to sign up.

Best,

Danny

real time systems, is on CRAN now.

Please upgrade now if you use these.

Best,

Danny
